title: ALMaQUEST. IV. The ALMA-MaNGA QUEnching and STar Formation (ALMaQUEST) Survey
question: How does sSFR depend on molecular gas fraction versus star formation efficiency, globally and at kpc scales, in MaNGA galaxies spanning starburst, main-sequence and green valley

what.value: xCOLD GASS comparison sample (offset 0.26 dex Chabrier to Salpeter)

evidence.quote: An offset of 0.26 dex has been added to the xCOLD GASS SFR and $\rm~M_{*}$ measurements to account for the conversion from the Chabrier to the Salpeter IMF.

what.value: PIPE3D global SFR and M* value-added catalog

evidence.quote: The global measurements of SFR and $\rm~M_{*}$ are taken from the PIPE3D (cite: san16a; san16b) value-added catalog (cite: san18)

what.value: HI-MaNGA DR2 and ALFALFA catalog HI data

evidence.quote: we use the $\rm H\textsc{i}$  data from both the second data release of $\rm H\textsc{i}$-MaNGA (D. Stark et al. in prep.) and the ALFALFA catalog (cite: hay18).

recipe.goal: Image CO cubes and moment maps
recipe.method: Clean continuum-subtracted data with Briggs weighting, re-image to 2.5'' beam and 0.5'' pixels; moments with IMMOMENTS
key_parameters: 4 sigma clipping for velocity and dispersion maps; no clipping for moment 0

recipe.goal: Derive H2 mass and global quantities
recipe.method: Sum CO flux, SFR and M* within 1.5 Re (star-forming [SII] BPT spaxels for SFR) and MaNGA bundle; compute sSFR, SFE, fH2
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.35 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1; Salpeter IMF

recipe.goal: Correlation of sSFR with SFE, fH2, HI ratios

recipe.method: Histograms of sSFR, fH2, SFE on star-forming spaxels per galaxy

evidence.quote: the correlation between sSFR and SFE ($\tau$ = 0.67)
A moderate correlation ($\tau$ = 0.56) with high significance
a stronger correlation strength ($\tau$ = 0.78) is found in the sSFR vs. SFE relation, with respect to the sSFR vs. $f_{\rm H_{2}}$ relation ($\tau$ = 0.49)

answer_key.quantity: Max difference in global H2 mass with varying alpha_CO
answer_key.value: 0.27 dex (mean ~0.05 and ~0.14 dex for methods 1 and 2)

evidence.quote: can be as large as 0.27 dex with an average value of $\sim 0.05$ and $\sim 0.14$ dex in method 1 and method 2, respectively

answer_key.quantity: HI detections among 33 galaxies with HI data

evidence.quote: of which 18 are detected in $\rm H\textsc{i}$  with S/N \> 5

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum spectral windows used for continuum subtraction
Velocity ranges chosen by hand for moment-0 maps per galaxy
tclean/CLEAN image size, masking, and deconvolver
Exact conversion of CO flux to L'CO and treatment of line brightness (R21 not needed but redshift/distance used)
Per-galaxy CASA version assignment beyond three listed
Spaxel S/N cuts for CO in resolved analysis
score_reason: Data public and tables give numbers, but imaging details sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA and MaNGA data; Tables 2-3 and Kendall tau values give numeric answer keys.
